items.title: totalPages undercounts when items do not divide evenly by pageSize
items.claim: paginate() floors totalPages, so hasNext is false while orders remain
items.reason: reproduced on 6333377: paginate([1,2,3],1,2) gives totalPages 1, hasNext false; clients following hasNext lose the last partial page; sequenced after T-001 because both edit the totalPages line (main:18, branch:23)

items.title: Validate and clamp pageSize in paginate()
items.claim: paginate() rejects pageSize below 1 and clamps above 100
items.reason: implemented in 6333377 with tests passing but not merged to main; status still pending; remaining work is review and merge

items.title: Reject zero or negative quantities when creating an order
items.claim: OrderStore.create accepts quantity 0 or negative, producing zero or negative totals
items.reason: create() checks customer and line count only; negative totals flow into the CSV export

items.title: README install command is misspelled as npm intsall
items.claim: README Run it block says npm intsall
items.reason: typo present on main and on the branch; first command a new reader copies

items.title: loadConfig accepts any defaultPageSize without validation
items.claim: loadConfig spreads config.local.json over defaults with no checks on defaultPageSize
items.reason: real but operator-only; cheap, fits spare capacity, and must follow T-001 because its 1-100 bound reuses MAX_PAGE_SIZE

items.title: Stream the CSV export instead of building it in memory
items.claim: ordersToCsv builds the whole export as one string before sending
items.reason: OrderStore already holds every order in memory (src/orders.ts:56), so streaming only removes one copy; worth doing once orders are persisted

items.title: CSV export breaks when a customer name contains a comma
items.claim: ordersToCsv joins raw fields, so a comma in a customer name shifts columns
items.reason: already delivered: csvField quotes commas, quotes, CR and LF; test covers comma and quote
items.evidence: commit 1b58281 (2026-10-17 16:48, before the item was filed at 16:53); src/export.ts:5-7; test/export.test.ts:24-27
